name: print-social-shopspring-sale-posts-pink-with-matisse-cutout-shapes
title: ShopSpring sale pack on pink with Matisse-style cut-out shapes and royal-blue serif
whatItIs: Five pink square posts with circle photos of a woman shopping for clothes, royal-blue serif headlines ('Spring Sale', 'Fashion Week'), mauve discount circles ('Up to 60%'), and scattered hand-cut shapes: flowers, leaves, squiggles, sparkles, dots and a hashtag sign.
whatItMeans: Joyful and fresh; paper-cut shapes feel handmade and springlike.
techniques: Scatter Matisse-like cut-out shapes around the frame.
Pair a single blue serif with a pink field.
Use a circle photo with a smaller offer circle overlapping it.

vocabulary.definition: Simple flat forms that look cut from paper.
Circles layered to link photo and offer.
